name: qalita-skills
description: QALITA's official Claude Code skills: create data quality packs, use the qalita CLI/platform, and deploy the QALITA platform.

plugins.name: qalita-pack-creation
plugins.description: Create and publish QALITA data quality packs (properties.yaml, pack_conf.json, main.py pattern, versioning, CI publish).

plugins.name: qalita-platform-cli
plugins.description: Use the qalita CLI/worker to authenticate, push sources and packs, run analyses, and manage jobs on the QALITA platform.

plugins.name: qalita-deployment
plugins.description: Deploy and configure the QALITA platform via Docker Compose or Helm, including LDAP, SMTP, and worker deployment.
